leo: Heads-up - new canary for orion13b-int4 started showing OOMs for >800 token generations. Seen on 2/6 canary nodes.
anya: can you share the config and log snippet?
leo: log: `RuntimeError: CUDA OOM allocating KV (wanted 1.0GB) node=canary-03 gpu_free=2.9G route=/generate/orion13b-int4 cfg: prefetch=true max_new_tokens_default=1024 batch_size=6 quant=q4_legacy`
devin: likely kv growth + allocator fragmentation. Immediate safety: set max_new_tokens_default=256, hard cap 512, prefetch=false, reduce batch_size to 3. Add ingress guard rejecting client max_tokens>512.
jia: also enable slot_compactor and run kv_prune for sessions older than 20m. For quality: schedule a q4_gptq compile and quick eval; int4 backends vary a lot.
leo: applying patch now. ops-bot: deployment "orion13b-int4-canary-20260321-1" updated: prefetch=false max_new_tokens_default=256 batch_size=3 ingress-guard=max_tokens<=512
anya: run compactor command on affected nodes: `runtask compactor --pool canary-ml --target=canary-02,canary-03`
leo: compactor run done, 15m smoke: 0 OOMs, gpu headroom +2.1GB.
devin: schedule A/B: two nodes remain on q4_legacy, two on q4_gptq to compare per-token-kv and QA eval. Add metric per_token_kv_bytes by backend.
jia: noted. follow-up: if q4_gptq reduces kv bytes ~15% and preserves EM we'll adopt it.
leo: will post results in 6h and open rollout ticket if stable.
